name: Even PTT Reader Simulator
postCreateCommand: bash -lc 'if ! command -v npm >/dev/null; then sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y curl ca-certificates && curl -fsSL https://deb.nodesource.com/setup_22.x | sudo -E bash - && sudo apt-get install -y nodejs; fi; npm install && sudo npm install -g @evenrealities/evenhub-cli @evenrealities/evenhub-simulator'
postStartCommand: bash -lc 'if ! pgrep -f "[v]ite" >/dev/null; then nohup npm run dev -- --host 0.0.0.0 >/tmp/even-ptt-vite.log 2>&1 & fi; if ! pgrep -f "[e]venhub-simulator" >/dev/null; then sleep 3; nohup npm run sim:headless >/tmp/even-ptt-simulator.log 2>&1 & fi'
